content: sops-nix README + autodocs: HM module (homeManagerModules.sops) example sets sops = { age.keyFile = '/home/user/.age-key.txt'; defaultSopsFile = ./secrets.yaml; secrets.<name> = { path = '%r/name'; }; }; age.generateKey=true auto-creates key if missing with 0600 perms. NixOS module exists separately (nixosModules.sops, /run/secrets). README .sops.yaml pattern: keys anchors + creation_rules with path_regex per secrets dir, key_groups with age: (NO leading dash on age under key_groups — a leading dash causes shamir multi-key requirement that breaks sops-nix). sops updatekeys re-keys existing files after adding recipients. sops age identity lookup default: ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt (SOPS docs, 2026-05-15). Per-host secrets colocated in hosts/<name>/secrets.yaml with path_regex mapping to that host's key is the community norm (frankper, nicolkrit999, sid115 guides).
